step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram shows Zoho's Site247 Real User Monitoring system. End users download scripts via CDN (CloudFront) and send monitoring beacon data to an Application Load Balancer (ALB), which forwards requests to EC2 collector instances. Collectors push metrics into an SQS queue. EC2 processor instances read from SQS, cache intermediate data in Redis (ElastiCache), and store final results in a Cassandra cluster. For viewing metrics, a Dashboard client issues API requests through a separate ALB to the EC2 processor instances to query Cassandra. Route 53 is visually present on the board as a component icon. All AWS services and actors are mapped using the strict dataset taxonomy and visually grounded edge connections.
